info.name: Data AVAX Supply Primary Network Rewards API

params.name: addresses
params.description: A comma separated list of X-Chain or P-Chain wallet addresses, starting with "avax"/"fuji", "P-avax"/"P-fuji" or "X-avax"/"X-fuji". One of addresses or nodeIds is required.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.

params.name: nodeIds
params.description: A comma separated list of node ids to filter by. One of addresses or nodeIds is required.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The order by which to sort results. Use "asc" for ascending order, "desc" for descending order. Sorted by timestamp or the `sortBy` query parameter, if provided.

items.docs: Lists pending rewards on the Primary Network for the supplied addresses.

params.name: nodeIds
params.description: A comma separated list of node ids to filter by. Optional, but at least one of addresses or nodeIds is required.

params.name: sortOrder

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency that return values should use. Defaults to USD.
